claims.title: Fixed-strength microscopic BGS universality for the maintained frozen map
claims.boundary: No current theorem supplies the model-specific Heisenberg-scale mixed cancellation/joint-trace estimate for the correctly desymmetrized fixed propagator.
claims.closure_condition: Prove the required model-specific Heisenberg-scale joint-trace or equivalent mixed-resolvent estimate on every compact Fourier support, then verify the stated unfolding and symmetry-class hypotheses.

claims.title: Pair-key and fourth-moment reduction
claims.boundary: Finite-field reduction; not a microscopic spectral theorem.

claims.title: Cayley additive-energy reduction
claims.boundary: Reduces the mixed layer to additive energy; does not close the centered pointwise target.

claims.title: Direct K^(8/3) Cayley energy bound in the explicit subgroup-size range
claims.boundary: Applies in the stated range; it does not reach the centered K^(2+o(1)) target.

claims.title: Uniform subgroup-curve Cayley energy bound
claims.boundary: Uniform K^(8/3)+K^4/p scale; does not prove centered quadratic pointwise energy.

claims.title: Sharp centered pointwise Cayley energy target
claims.boundary: Existing pointwise, support, and averaged estimates do not give E_+(A)=(K-1)^4/p+O(K^(2+o(1))) in the intended sparse/intermediate regime.
claims.closure_condition: Prove the centered K^(2+o(1)) estimate, or an equivalent common-split-divisor theorem strong enough to imply it.

claims.title: Frozen-model classical symmetry theorem
claims.boundary: Excludes ordinary C1 centralizers/reversors and relevant affine C1 conjugacies in the stated small-coupling range; does not exclude N-dependent quantum symmetries or prove BGS.

claims.title: Odd-Pell full-symbol Gaussian crossover
claims.boundary: Frozen epsilon_K=tau N_K lies outside the proved bounded crossover window.

claims.title: Fixed-map moment controls, falsifier, and perturbation transfer
claims.ledger_status: EXACT IDENTITIES / PROJECT ASYMPTOTIC CONSEQUENCES + FRESH REGRESSION
claims.boundary: Low-order and one-orientation loop information does not identify CUE.

claims.title: Three-orientation mixed-resolvent lower barrier
claims.boundary: Normalized mixed-residual decay hypotheses remain unproved for the frozen propagator.

claims.title: Active Lean algebraic/finite kernel graph
claims.boundary: Source presence does not establish compilation; analytic BGS theorems are not formalized.

claims.title: Full vanishing-noise tomography transition
claims.boundary: Existing fixed-noise and binary-pair results do not characterize the full moment-class minimax transition when channel noise vanishes with copy budget.
claims.closure_condition: Determine matching minimax upper and lower transitions for the full moment class in the varying-noise regime.

claims.title: Full mixed loop hierarchy implies target compact anchored correlations
claims.boundary: The external characterization is available; the model-specific approximate mixed hierarchy remains open.

claims.title: Sharp Fourier-line resonance coercivity
claims.boundary: Closes Fourier-line classes in the stated coercive range; arbitrary two-dimensional analytic symbols remain open.

claims.title: Local-jet resonance obstruction
claims.ledger_status: EXACT LOCAL CONSTRUCTION + FRESH SYMBOLIC REGRESSION
claims.boundary: Local polynomial counterexample; not a periodic torus counterexample.

claims.title: All-members analytic resonance nondegeneracy
claims.boundary: Generic positivity and Fourier-line classes are closed, but the nonlinear analytic coboundary equation is unresolved for arbitrary nonconstant real-analytic observables.
claims.closure_condition: Prove impossibility of a nonconstant real-analytic solution to the stated nonlinear coboundary equation, or construct one.

claims.title: Harmonic return law for the actual kicked Pell propagator
claims.boundary: Fixed multiplicity and logarithmic return time; not Heisenberg-scale microscopic BGS.

claims.title: Harmonic-scale global transition in the fixed Pell cat map
claims.boundary: Global compressed-observable law; not local eigenphase statistics of a fixed propagator.

claims.title: Partition-Mobius formula for distinct-index spectral sums
claims.boundary: Deterministic finite-N identity.

claims.title: Exact Fourier trace representation of microscopic factorial statistics
claims.boundary: Compact Fourier support probes trace powers of order N.

claims.title: Weighted Heisenberg-scale joint-trace comparison is sufficient for band-limited microscopic RMT correlations
claims.boundary: Sufficiency theorem only; the required model-specific Heisenberg-scale estimate is open.

claims.title: Every-compact-bandwidth comparison extends to Schwartz correlation tests
claims.boundary: Requires positive normalized spectral averages and a reference Schwartz limit; a single fixed bandwidth is insufficient.

claims.title: Model-specific Heisenberg-scale desymmetrized joint-trace estimate
claims.boundary: The deterministic bridge is closed, but no current theorem proves the required weighted joint-trace or equivalent mixed-resolvent cancellation for the frozen propagator at powers of order N.
claims.closure_condition: Prove the correctly desymmetrized weighted joint-trace comparison, or an equivalent mixed-resolvent hierarchy, uniformly on every compact Fourier support.

registry_scope: Core load-bearing claims, theorem bridges, and open programme obligations. The claim ledger remains the complete status authority and may contain additional scoped results not assigned a stable core ID.
